lead_headline: Land Plots Put Up for Sale in Kalkan
lead_deck: New Privatisation Tender Begins in Antalya
lead_body: Land plots have been put up for sale in Side and Kalkan, Antalya. The land plots sold as part of the privatisation tender are seen as an important step for tourism investments. As tourism activities increase in Kalkan and Side, positive effects are also expected on the region's economy.

col3_body: Summer activity is being experienced in villa tourism in Kaş and Kalkan
magazine_lead_body: Asat Veznesi has opened in Kalkan and started contributing to the region's tourism activities
